title: Donate — Carlo Ruggiero
description: Support for building and releasing more software openly. Entirely optional, through Buy Me a Coffee, GitHub Sponsors, PayPal or Liberapay.
summary: If something here has been useful, you can help towards the next one.
name: Donate
lede: If something I've made has been useful to you, and you'd like to help with what comes next, this is the place. Thank you for even considering it.

sections.heading: Ways to give

services.name: Buy me a coffee
services.text: A small one-off, no account needed.

services.name: GitHub Sponsors
services.text: Monthly or one-off, right next to the code.

services.name: PayPal
services.text: A one-off amount, if you already have an account.

services.name: Liberapay
services.text: Recurring, and run as a non-profit itself.

sections.note: Nothing is taken on this site. Each link hands you to that service, which handles the payment.

sections.heading: What it supports
text: Donations go towards building and releasing more software, and towards releasing more of it openly. Open source is the part of this work I enjoy most, and support is what makes it easier to keep choosing.

terms.label: The time to build things properly
terms.text: Getting something finished, and then keeping it maintained, takes rather more evenings than a first release suggests. Support is what keeps that going.

terms.label: More of it in the open
terms.text: There are projects I would like to work on publicly, and nothing that is closed today is closed forever — opening more of it up later is something I would like to do.

terms.label: Somewhere to run it
terms.text: Hosting for the apps I run for people and for the demos, so anyone can try something without installing it first.

sections.heading: Or help without paying
text: Just as welcome, and sometimes worth more:

items.label: Tell me what breaks
items.text: A clear report with steps to reproduce is genuinely valuable. Issues go on GitHub.

items.label: Mention it to someone
items.text: A word in the right place reaches further than anything I can post myself.

items.label: Translate something
items.text: What I release ships in English and Italian. Another language is always a welcome pull request.

items.label: Just say hello
items.text: Hearing that something is being used, and what for, is a good reason to keep going.
